dimensions.question: Does every reading shown trace to something the runtime actually reported, with an unmeasured metric shown as unavailable rather than as a plausible number?
Does the copy treat the Cockpit as an optional, experimental UI that is design and planning only, instead of a shipped or production feature?
Does it refuse to draw, generate, or substitute a character in the copilot slot, and hold the mascot for maintainer approval before any upstream pull request?
Does it speak about fit on the actual machine (dedicated VRAM, unified memory, or RAM only) rather than a generic model leaderboard?
After twenty seconds, can a first-time reader say what Turbofit does for a machine and which readings are measured?

decision_rule: Accept only when telemetry_honesty, cockpit_status_boundary, and mascot_boundary pass and no weighted dimension is below 3/5. Reject any line that presents an invented metric as measured, or that presents the Cockpit as a finished product. A human review can override a model score only with a recorded reason.
